integrity: Analytical proof supplied for every stated limit; a finite standard-library checker provides supporting consistency checks and is not an infinite proof. Prior literature acknowledged, no independent priority certification.
limitations: No rates uniform in dimension or variable weights, no graph-isomorphism reconstruction, no higher-order endpoint terms; possible equivalent earlier unindexed derivation.
scientific_scope: Fixed dimension d at least two; finite simple graph with positive finite weights; sufficiently small positive Gram-adjacency perturbation; distribution of squared distance of two uniform points in the resulting parallelotope.
title: Graph-cut spectra from near-diameter distances in almost orthogonal parallelotopes
